use_case: Consumer generative AI chatbot used to compare insurer quotes and policy forms and to draft coverage summaries and renewal emails
vendor_or_model: Consumer generative AI chatbot vendor (general-purpose large language model); consumer terms allow training on chats; no data protection terms
data_categories: Pasted declarations pages, applications, prior claims, vehicle identification numbers; driver license numbers for 7 clients (nonpublic personal information; some 501.171 personal information)
consequential_decision_category: Insurance (coverage comparisons that shape the agent's recommendation; insurers make underwriting decisions)
human_in_the_loop: Licensed agent reads every draft before it reaches a client; no check against the policy forms before the assessment (one wrong windstorm deductible caught in July 2026)
applicable_laws: Rule 69O-128.002(16)(b) (agent exception depends on permitted disclosures); Fla. Stat. 501.171(2) reasonable measures and possible breach analysis; Carrier DSA (insurer policyholder information)
status: Retired (used 2026-04-06 to 2026-08-04; paused 2026-08-05; consumer plan stopped 2026-09-14; replacement only under the P10 conditions)

use_case: AMS built-in AI assistant that drafts client emails and summarizes activity notes
vendor_or_model: AMS vendor (feature added in the 2026-06 release; vendor AI terms: no training of shared models on customer data; prompts kept 30 days)
data_categories: Client names, policy details, activity notes inside the AMS (nonpublic personal information)
consequential_decision_category: None (drafting and summaries; no coverage or eligibility decisions)
human_in_the_loop: Owner edits and sends each draft; summaries checked against the source notes before use in client advice
applicable_laws: Rule 69O-128 (disclosure to the AMS vendor is within the existing AMS contract); Fla. Stat. 501.171(2)
status: In production (approved 2026-09-14 with conditions: Restricted data never pasted into prompts; confirm SOC 2 coverage at the next report)
